theme.en: China’s Tool Push Meets an AI Reset
theme.zh: 中国设备突进遇上AI供应链重估

dek.en: Domestic immersion-DUV production and new industrial capital sharpen China’s semiconductor ambitions. At the same time, HBM earnings, export-access talks, and edge-AI deals show that AI’s supply chain is being repriced rather than simply expanding.
dek.zh: 国产浸没式DUV设备量产与新增产业资本，正在强化中国的半导体雄心。与此同时，HBM业绩、对华出口准入磋商和边缘AI交易表明，AI供应链正被重新定价，而非单纯扩张。

title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: TDK and LG Innotek Partner on Physical-AI Sensors
title.zh: TDK与LG Innotek合作开发Physical AI传感器

summary.en: TDK and LG Innotek have formed a strategic partnership on sensing technologies for physical-AI applications, initially targeting vision and tactile modules for humanoid robots. The pairing combines TDK’s sensor portfolio with LG Innotek’s optics and precision-module manufacturing, shifting attention from robot compute chips to the sensor stack that feeds them.
summary.zh: TDK与LG Innotek建立战略合作，将面向Physical AI开发传感技术，首批目标是人形机器人的视觉和触觉模组。双方把TDK的传感器产品线与LG Innotek的光学及精密模组制造结合，焦点从机器人计算芯片延伸至为其提供输入的传感器栈。

title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC’s JASM Fab Resumes After Kyushu Earthquake Checks
title.zh: 九州地震后，台积电JASM工厂完成检查并复工

summary.en: TSMC’s JASM fab in Kumamoto resumed operations after safety inspections following an earthquake in Kyushu. The quick restart limits the immediate risk of a supply interruption at TSMC’s Japanese manufacturing base, though seismic events remain an operational risk for geographically concentrated advanced-chip production.
summary.zh: 九州发生地震后，台积电位于熊本的JASM工厂完成安全检查并恢复运营。快速复工降低了日本制造基地短期供应中断的风险，但地震仍凸显先进芯片产能地域集中的运营风险。

title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix Profit Jumps 557%, but Misses Estimates
title.zh: SK hynix利润增长557%，但仍低于市场预期

summary.en: SK hynix reported a record second-quarter profit, up 557% year on year, but its result missed market estimates. The contrast is important for the AI-memory trade: HBM demand and pricing can deliver exceptional earnings while investors remain focused on whether supply, mix, and expectations have already moved ahead of reported results.
summary.zh: SK hynix公布创纪录的第二季度利润，同比增幅达557%，但业绩仍低于市场预期。这一反差对AI存储逻辑很关键：HBM需求和价格能够带来异常强劲的盈利，但投资者仍会审视供给、产品组合与市场预期是否已跑在实际业绩之前。

title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: China Starts Production of Home-Grown Immersion DUV Tools
title.zh: 中国开始量产国产浸没式DUV芯片制造设备

summary.en: China has started production of domestically developed immersion-DUV chipmaking tools, Reuters reported, citing a source. Immersion DUV is not a substitute for EUV at leading-edge nodes, but a working domestic supply chain could matter materially for mature-node capacity and for reducing exposure to foreign tool restrictions.
summary.zh: 路透社援引消息人士称，中国已开始生产自主研发的浸没式DUV芯片制造设备。浸没式DUV并不能替代先进制程所需的EUV，但可用的国产供应链将对成熟制程产能及降低对海外设备限制的暴露产生实质影响。

title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Nvidia’s Huang Meets U.S. Officials on China Chip Access
title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋就中国芯片准入问题会见美国官员

summary.en: Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang met U.S. officials as questions over Chinese access to AI chips continue to grow. The engagement underscores that commercial demand for Nvidia hardware is now inseparable from export-control interpretation, licensing, and the political acceptability of serving China.
summary.zh: 随着中国获取AI芯片的问题持续升温，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋会见了美国官员。这一互动说明，英伟达硬件的商业需求已与出口管制的解释、许可证以及向中国供货的政治可接受性密不可分。

title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: Teradyne Profit Rises on Semiconductor-Test Demand
title.zh: 半导体测试需求推动泰瑞达利润增长

summary.en: Teradyne’s profit rose on semiconductor-testing demand, the Wall Street Journal reported. Test demand is a useful read-through for the industry because more complex AI, memory, and automotive devices increase both test intensity and the value of equipment suppliers after wafer fabrication.
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》报道，半导体测试需求推动泰瑞达利润上升。测试需求是行业的重要观察指标，因为更复杂的AI、存储和汽车芯片会提高测试强度，也会提升晶圆制造之后设备供应商的价值。

title.zh: 新兴挑战者
Microchip收购边缘AI芯片初创公司Hailo

summary.en: Microchip has acquired edge-AI chip startup Hailo, according to EE Times. The deal gives the embedded-chip vendor a more direct accelerator position as inference shifts into cameras, industrial systems, and other power-constrained endpoints, while removing an independent challenger from the market.
summary.zh: 据EE Times报道，Microchip已收购边缘AI芯片初创公司Hailo。这笔交易让这家嵌入式芯片厂商更直接地进入加速器市场；随着推理向摄像头、工业系统及其他受功耗约束的终端迁移，市场中也少了一家独立挑战者。

title.en: Quadric Extends Series C to $46 Million
title.zh: Quadric将C轮融资扩大至4600万美元

summary.en: Quadric extended its Series C financing to $46 million in a second close led by the International Finance Corporation, taking total capital secured to about $90 million. The funding gives the programmable edge-AI company more runway to commercialize its products as customers look for alternatives to cloud-centric inference.
summary.zh: Quadric在国际金融公司领投的二次交割中，将C轮融资扩大至4600万美元，使其累计获得的资金约达9000万美元。这笔融资为这家可编程边缘AI公司提供了更长的商业化周期，正值客户寻求云端中心化推理替代方案之际。

theme.en: Hardware-Aware AI Reaches the System Stack
theme.zh: 硬件感知AI走向系统全栈

dek.en: This week’s work pushes model and system optimization into memory arrays, routing, inference dispatch, and verification. The strongest claims pair algorithmic changes with concrete hardware constraints or measured execution results.
dek.zh: 本周研究将模型与系统优化推进到存储阵列、布线、推理调度和验证等环节。较有价值的工作将算法改动与明确的硬件约束或实测执行结果结合起来。

title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Multi-Primitive In-Memory Computing for Monte Carlo Tree Search
title.zh: 用于蒙特卡洛树搜索的多原语存内计算

papers.authors: T. Molom-Ochir, B. F. Morris, et al.

summary.en: The paper maps the phases of Monte Carlo tree search to separate in-memory primitives, including CAM, logic, RRAM crossbars, and SRAM, rather than treating the irregular algorithm as a single crossbar workload. Using 22 nm estimates calibrated with fabricated RRAM-array parameters, it reports about 60 mW for 9×9 Go and 96× CPU energy efficiency. The claim is compelling because it tackles an irregular search algorithm, but the end-to-end system is still an architecture evaluation rather than measured silicon.
summary.zh: 论文将蒙特卡洛树搜索的各阶段分别映射到CAM、逻辑、RRAM交叉阵列和SRAM等存内原语，而不是把这类不规则算法视为单一交叉阵列工作负载。基于采用已制备RRAM阵列参数校准的22 nm估算，其对9×9围棋报告约60 mW功耗和相对CPU 96倍的能效。该工作的重要性在于处理了不规则搜索算法，但端到端系统仍属架构评估而非实测芯片。

title.en: Distribution-Aware MoE Inference with Adaptive Kernel Dispatch
title.zh: 采用自适应核调度的分布感知MoE推理

papers.authors: E.-M. Huang, A.-C. Chang, et al.

summary.en: DA-MoE chooses fused-MoE GPU kernels from the live expert-routing histogram instead of only from token-count buckets. On HumanEval-X serving traces, the authors report geometric-mean latency gains of 1.16× for DeepSeek-V3 and 1.29× for Kimi K2, with peaks of 1.40× and 1.56×. It identifies routing skew as a first-class systems variable, although the benefit depends on representative offline tuning and the serving mix matching those distributions.
summary.zh: DA-MoE根据实时专家路由直方图选择融合MoE GPU内核，而非仅依据token数量分桶。在HumanEval-X服务轨迹上，作者报告DeepSeek-V3的几何平均延迟改善为1.16倍、Kimi K2为1.29倍，峰值分别达1.40倍和1.56倍。该工作将路由偏斜提升为一等系统变量，但收益依赖有代表性的离线调优及实际服务负载与这些分布的匹配度。

title.en: FusionML: CPU+GPU Co-Execution on Unified-Memory Apple Silicon
title.zh: FusionML：统一内存Apple Silicon上的CPU+GPU协同执行

summary.en: FusionML shows that MLX lazy-graph scheduling can serialize CPU–GPU work unless an eager materialization boundary is inserted, then uses contention-aware row splitting for transformer prefill. Across five Apple chips, it reports 1.15–1.38× faster decoder-block prefill and 1.18–1.25× faster time to first token for Qwen2.5-7B, with unchanged decode throughput. The useful result is that shared memory alone does not guarantee operator-level parallelism.
summary.zh: FusionML指出，若不插入即时物化边界，MLX的惰性图调度会将CPU-GPU工作串行化；随后它为Transformer prefill采用了考虑争用的行切分。在五款Apple芯片上，作者报告解码器块prefill加速1.15至1.38倍，Qwen2.5-7B的首token时间加速1.18至1.25倍，而decode吞吐不变。其关键结论是：统一内存本身并不保证算子级并行。

title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Magnetic Tunnel Junctions for Timekeeping in Intermittent Systems
title.zh: 利用磁隧道结实现间歇计算系统计时

papers.authors: N. V. Maruszewski, J. Athas, et al.

summary.en: FLINT uses deliberately stochastic retention loss in magnetic tunnel junctions to estimate off-time in batteryless intermittent systems, avoiding capacitor-discharge timing. A model validated against 21 fabricated MTJs reports 15 minutes of off-time within 10% error at 1.03 μJ and under 0.1 mm². The result points to a useful nonvolatile timing primitive, though system performance beyond the device-trace-driven evaluation remains to be demonstrated in hardware.
summary.zh: FLINT利用磁隧道结中可预测的随机保持失效来估计无电池间歇系统的断电时间，从而避免采用电容放电计时。以21个已制备MTJ验证的模型报告，在1.03 μJ和不足0.1 mm²条件下，可在15分钟断电时间内实现10%以内误差。该结果提出了一种有潜力的非易失计时原语，但设备轨迹驱动评估之外的完整硬件系统性能仍待验证。

title.zh: EDA与设计验证
DRC-Aid：验证闭环的设计规则修复

papers.authors: A. Mukherjee, K. He, K. Roy

summary.en: DRC-Aid limits an LLM to choose among rule-engine-generated geometric edits and immediately verifies each choice with physical-design tools. On FreePDK45 layouts, it reports DRC-clean, LVS-equivalent repair in about 92.5% of cases and a 98% reduction in total violations. Its strongest choice is constraining the model with deterministic edits and verification, though the evaluation is on an academic process kit rather than production designs.
summary.zh: DRC-Aid将LLM限制为从规则引擎生成的几何编辑中进行选择，并用物理设计工具立即验证每次选择。在FreePDK45版图上，它报告约92.5%的案例可实现DRC清洁且LVS等价的修复，总违规数减少98%。其最强之处是用确定性编辑和验证约束模型，但评估基于学术工艺库而非量产设计。

title.zh: 量子计算

title.en: ARGON: GNN-Guided Compilation for Neutral-Atom Computing
title.zh: ARGON：面向中性原子计算的GNN引导编译框架

papers.authors: W. Sun, X. Li, et al.

summary.en: ARGON separates neutral-atom compilation into an offline library of hardware-certified spatial layouts and a GNN-guided temporal-routing stage. The approach is intended to avoid movement and conflict bottlenecks as circuits grow while preserving highly parallel entangling operations. It is a practical compiler direction for dynamic-atom hardware, but its value will depend on how well the precomputed layout library captures changing device constraints and error behavior.
summary.zh: ARGON将中性原子编译拆分为离线构建的硬件认证空间布局库，以及由GNN引导的时间路由阶段。该方法旨在随着电路规模增长时规避原子移动和冲突瓶颈，同时保留高度并行的纠缠操作。这是面向动态原子硬件的务实编译方向，但其价值取决于预计算布局库对不断变化的器件约束和误差行为的覆盖程度。
